label: Ox Alpha
war_summary: War 139 is on day 110 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated on the flanks — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many rear hexes; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse and others — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the previous snapshot (~3h ago), Endless Shore remains the most active region (49 events/24h, with fresh events in the last 2 hours at Woodbind, The Overland, Old Jack Tar) and shows a near-even 5-5 split with massive accelerating casualties (~600/hr per side in the last 2h window). Oarbreaker has cooled somewhat since its surge (45 events/24h, latest event ~3.5h old) but saw heavy back-and-forth at Posterus, Grisly Refuge, and Partisan Island. Marban Hollow is surging with fresh events in the last 2 hours at Sanctum and The Spitrocks and very high accelerating casualties (~450/hr per side). Callahan's Passage shows extreme accelerating casualties (~300/hr per side) with recent flips at Overlook Hill and Scáth Passing, though its latest event is ~6h old. Olavis Wake is a major hotspot with the highest current casualty rate (~800/hr Colonial, ~640/hr Warden) following the Ilmari Bridge flip. Godcrofts remains a tight 5-4 Warden-lead knife-fight (25 events/24h at Saegio, Argosa, Isawa). Secondary fronts include Clahstra (11 events, heavy casualties), Onyx (11 events), Mooring County (12 events at Borderlane), Speaking Woods, and Stlican Shelf, though several of these have gone quiet in the last few hours. Quiet rear regions remain static and unlikely to change hands.

The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Clahstra continues escalating hard (~1050-1370/hr per side over 2h) with heavy fighting at Transept (9 events/24h), Bewailing Fort and East Narthex; the latest event was minutes before cutoff and the split stands 5-3 Warden. Onyx remains extremely intense (~1240-1370/hr per side over 2h, accelerating) with The Waif as a hotspot (10 events/24h), split 3 Colonial - 2 Warden - 1 NONE. Speaking Woods shows sustained heavy fighting (~550-700/hr over 2h, ~9.5k casualties/24h each side) with recent activity at The Filament, Hush and Stem; split 5-3 Warden. Endless Shore has cooled sharply from its prior surge (~150/hr per side over 2h vs ~400+ earlier) but still logged 38 events/24h around Woodbind, Brackish Point and The Overland; it remains 10-0 Colonial. Oarbreaker has reignited dramatically: 33 events/24h (Grisly Refuge alone 12), rates spiking to ~95-125/hr over 2h after near-zero, latest event at cutoff, split 6-3 Colonial. Marban Hollow cooled somewhat (~100-155/hr over 2h) but logged 10 events/24h at Sanctum and Lockheed, 4-4. Mooring County stays active (8 events/24h at Borderlane/Luch's Workshop, latest ~45min ago) though colonial casualties are cooling while warden casualties accelerate. Godcrofts, StemaLanding, Tempest Island and Tyrant Foothills show moderate ongoing fighting. Quiet rear hexes remain static.

war_summary: War 140 enters its third day with sharp, escalating engagements across the central and coastal sectors. Heavy bloodletting defines the Dead Lands, Endless Shore, and Tempest Island, where combined casualties have already exceeded several thousands amidst fierce back-and-forth fighting. In Farranac Coast and the Drowned Vale, front lines remain exceptionally fluid, with each sector recording eleven base turnover events in the opening hours as key holdings such as Terra, Scythe, and Eastmarch are contested. headline: War 140's Eighth Day: Southern Fronts Trade Bases
war_summary: The latest returns, filed some five hours after the previous edition, find War 140 in its eighth day with the southern map still changing hands. Marban Hollow and Tempest Island have been the sharpest spots: seven base events in Marban and eight in Tempest within the past two hours, with both colors recording captures. Endless Shore leads the tally with thirty-two ownership events in a day and remains split five and five. Drowned Vale is close behind at twenty, and Farranac Coast has logged sixteen, its casualty rolls climbing to match. Stlican Shelf has become active, with a cluster of flips around Thornhold. Clahstra is now entirely Colonial-held, while the Deadlands, so hot earlier, has gone quiet. Hourly enlistment is cooling in many districts, but two-hour casualty trends in the contested zones are still climbing, suggesting the night's work is far from done.

colonial_reinforce.reason: The Baths anchors the Colonial central Drowned Vale line; with Warden losses high and rising in the region, holding this town base preserves the staging area for further captures.

colonial_attack.reason: The Warden relic at The Wash sits immediately beside a Colonial keep of the same name; heavy Warden casualties in DrownedVale make it the best near-term objective.

warden_reinforce.reason: The Bone Haft is the last Warden town base in Farranac; despite Colonial pressure, Wardens are taking fewer casualties than Colonials, so reinforcing here can hold the region.

warden_attack.reason: Scarp of Ambrose is a Colonial staging point adjacent to The Bone Haft; Warden efficiency in Farranac makes a counterattack here the most direct way to relieve the town.

war_summary: Since our last edition the war has entered its bloodiest stretch yet. The central corridor burns without pause: the Dead Lands alone have counted over five thousand casualties a side, while Drowned Vale, Endless Shore, Farranac Coast, and Weathered Expanse each report totals running into the thousands, with fresh losses still arriving at hundreds per hour despite a brief cooling in the latest readings. Ownership continues to seesaw. Drowned Vale logged twenty base events in a day, its Wash and Eastmarch posts changing hands repeatedly, and Endless Shore matched that fury with thirty-two events around Woodbind and Wellchurch. Farranac Coast leans Colonial at ten bases to one, yet Warden columns struck back through Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy, where nine captures were recorded. Fisherman's Row went heavily to the Wardens, while Clahstra and Kings Cage swung Colonial. Tempest Island and Marban Hollow remain open sores, trading posts through the night. Quiet reigns elsewhere — Godcrofts, Mooring County, and their neighbors sit undisturbed behind undisputed flags. Thirty-four victory towns are required for victory; none has fallen.

Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties though no base events, suggesting pressure without movement. Rear regions from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.

Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single base event, pressure without recorded movement. By contrast, Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm have cooled markedly in recent hours, while rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.

war_summary: The ledger of the Dead Lands grows heavier by the hour. Since our last edition the region's dead have risen to ten thousand five hundred Colonial and eleven thousand eight hundred Warden names, with fresh base activity logged as recently as this morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow above all, and the balance of strongpoints there has shifted to seven Wardens against four Colonials. Endless Shore remains the day's busiest field with forty-two recorded events around Woodbind, Saltbrook Channel and Wellchurch, though its last entry came hours ago and the front has since gone quiet on current readings. Drowned Vale, which roared overnight at Eastmarch and The Wash, has likewise fallen silent in recent hours. Farranac Coast shows nine bases Colonial to two Warden with warden losses accelerating sharply, while Loch Mor bleeds heavily at Westmarch and Market Road and Marban Hollow's toll is climbing fast despite a thin six-to-two Colonial edge. Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single recorded base movement. Elsewhere the map holds firm: rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns are required before any victor may be declared.

headline: Kings Cage Erupts as Fishermen's Row and Stlican Shelf Trade Blows
war_summary: The storm has shifted. Kings Cage, little noted in our last edition, now pours out the war's fiercest new toll — better than three thousand casualties in the past two hours, the rate still climbing, with the day's seven base events all logged at Den of Knaves, the latest shortly before this edition went to press. Fishermen's Row keeps its grip on the exchange ledger: seven more base events inside two hours, Dankana Post the busiest of all, and the Colonials now hold three of nine works to the Wardens' six. Stlican Shelf bleeds at an accelerating pace, its latest base movement recorded at filing time, while Tempest Island saw fresh fighting at Isle of Psyche in the same hour. Linn Mercy, which led our last edition with twenty-nine base events, has slowed to a trickle, ten of its eleven works now Warden-held. The Deadlands remain the bloodiest field, some thirty-four thousand lost there in a day, though the two-hour pace has eased and no base event has been recorded since midmorning. Endless Shore has gone quiet since morning and Stonecradle's late flare has cooled, but the Weathered Expanse, untouched on the base ledger, still feeds the casualty columns.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Eastknife is the nearest Colonial base to Den of Knaves, which just flipped back to the Wardens amid an exploding Warden offensive tempo (1460 warden casualties/hr, +1061 vs the prior hour) and a 153/hr enlistment influx; it should be garrisoned and entrenched before the Warden push rolls south.

colonial_attack.reason: Dankana Post has flipped repeatedly and the Wardens only retook it in the last hour; Colonial attack tempo (21 colonial casualties/hr, +13 vs prior hour) now exceeds the Warden rate (13/hr) and Wardens lost more over 24h (1949 vs 1688), so an immediate, consolidated Colonial assault to re-take and hold it is the highest-value local objective.

warden_reinforce.reason: Den of Knaves was only re-captured at ~17:20-17:35 and is the Wardens' sole KingsCage foothold in the packet, under a Colonial counterattack tempo of 912 colonial casualties per hour rising +440; digging in and stocking it now protects the staging point for the ongoing push.

warden_attack.reason: DeadLands carries the heaviest Warden offensive tempo in the packet (1596 warden casualties/hr, +270 vs prior hour, colonial-to-warden loss ratio 0.817) and The Pits is the central Colonial relic sitting between Abandoned Ward and Callahan's Boot on that axis; concentrating the Warden assault there offers the best conversion of ongoing attrition into a capture.

headline: Stema Landing Wakes Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
war_summary: Stema Landing opens this dispatch: four base events in the past two hours, the newest logged some twenty minutes before filing, with The Wane the busiest post and all nine of its works still in Colonial hands. Fishermen's Row, our last edition's lead, remains the day's busiest ground, twenty-three events on the day's ledger and three more in the latest span; its nine works now stand eight Warden to one Colonial, a further turn from the seven-two split last reported, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post again drawing the fire. Godcrofts has cooled to a single recent event, and its lone no-man's-land post has been restored, putting all nine works in Warden hands. The Deadlands have filed no base events for more than five hours, yet combined losses near four thousand in the past two hours and still climb; The Salt March and Callahan's Boot remain the contested posts, and eight of eleven works are Colonial-held. Tempest Island keeps one work in no-man's-land, while Linn of Mercy and Farranac Coast, quiet on bases, show steeply rising losses. The Weathered Expanse, likewise silent, counts better than fourteen thousand casualties a side over the day. This is the eightieth day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Callahan's Boot is a weak Town Base I sitting dead-center of the war's hottest front, where Warden attack tempo is spiking (1502 casualties/hr and rising); it has already cycled hands twice today, so garrisoning and rebuilding it now blunts the Warden southern push.

colonial_attack.reason: Iron's End is the softest (Relic) and nearest Warden holdfast to the contested Colonial center; counterattacking it threatens the flank of the Warden offensive while Colonial casualties per hour remain lower than Warden losses.

warden_reinforce.reason: Peripti Landing has changed hands three times today and sits on the active west flank; with Colonial enlistments surging (+897/24h) and Colonial loss rates still elevated, Wardens should rebuild and garrison it before the next Colonial wave arrives.

warden_attack.reason: Fort Guile is a fragile relic in the contested north that has already flipped twice, and Warden attack tempo in Lykos is rising (95.5/hr with positive change) while roughly matching Colonial losses; pressing it before Colonials consolidate the north converts existing momentum.

headline: Farranac Coast Erupts as Tempest Island Holds Busiest Hours
war_summary: The flare of the hour burns on Farranac Coast, four base actions inside two hours with Scythe the busiest works on that sheet, its losses now running past three thousand the hour between the armies. Tempest Island keeps pace close behind, thirteen actions across the day and the freshest report in the field, Blackwatch, the Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate all touched. Lykos Isle, hottest in our last dispatch, has slackened to a single action in two hours, though twenty-five stand across the day and Fort Guile and The Squall remain its most-worked grounds. Godcrofts has stirred anew around Lipsia, and Fishermen's Row stays busy at Arcadia and Peripti Landing. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their casualty ledger is the war's second grimmest; the Weathered Expanse, silent in works, tops it with more than thirty-three thousand losses in a day. This is the ninety-eighth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

Lykos Isle is likewise still in motion, with five events in two hours and fourteen on the day, led by Mārudia, Fort Guile, and Cyrus. Weathered Expanse remains active as well—two events in the latest two-hour window, nine on the day, most often at Spirit Watch and Foxcatcher—and its 24-hour losses are enormous: more than twenty thousand Colonial and twenty-three thousand Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf has re-emerged as a contested sector, registering one flip in the past two hours and eight on the day at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. DeadLands, quiet in the previous edition's recent windows, now shows two fresh events at The Salt March and Callahan's Boot. Farranac Coast has produced no flips in the past two hours but retains eleven on the day, concentrated around Mara and Terra.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Wardens captured Callahan's Boot and are applying heavy pressure in central DeadLands; reinforcing Abandoned Ward prevents a breakthrough toward the Colonial interior.

colonial_attack.reason: Colonial offensive in WeatheredExpanse is causing heavy Warden casualties; attacking Huntsfort exploits momentum and threatens Warden central positions.

warden_reinforce.reason: Huntsfort is under imminent Colonial assault; reinforcing is critical to hold the central WeatheredExpanse line.

warden_attack.reason: The Satyr Stone is the last Colonial base in FishermansRow; attacking it would clear the region and deny Colonial staging.

war_summary: Since our last edition the base war has quickened. Fishermans Row stands busiest of all fields — thirty-eight actions in the day, ten in the past two hours, the newest logged forty-five minutes before press, with Fort Ember, Arcadia, and Peripti Landing the day's pivots — its works holding at eight Warden to one Colonial. The Dead Lands, after the night's passage of The Salt March into Warden keeping, stirred again within the hour, two fresh actions on the books and the field divided six Colonial to five Warden. Lykos Isle filed the war's newest action, scarce half an hour before this edition, the fourteenth of its day, with one work left in ruin. The Weathered Expanse packed all nine of the day's actions into six hours, its newest past five o'clock, though the casualty flood there cools — above twenty thousand Colonial and nearly twenty-four thousand Warden losses in the day. Farranac Coast has shifted no work since four o'clock, yet bleeds faster, past four hundred an hour apiece. Stlican Shelf, Warden save one work, grapples on at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. The ledger reads two hundred forty-seven Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, one work to the Colonial good since our last accounting. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-second day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

colonial_attack.reason: Huntsfort is an exposed central Warden relic sitting between the new Colonial salients at Foxcatcher/Necropolis and Wightwalk; the Colonial southern offensive took four bases in roughly four hours and Wardens are bleeding faster, so pressing Huntsfort keeps momentum before the Warden line around Crow's Nest reforms.

warden_reinforce.reason: Callahan's Boot was only just retaken and is wedged between Colonial Abandoned Ward and The Pits in the highest-intensity region on the map; with Wardens losing roughly 30% more casualties than Colonials over 24 hours, this fresh gain will be tested quickly and needs entrenchment and garrison.

warden_attack.reason: The Old Mourn is the lone Colonial base on an otherwise Warden-held shelf; Wardens surround it and currently out-attrite the Colonial raiding force there, so a concentrated recapture restores a clean front line and removes a staging point.

war_summary: Three hours have shifted the temper of the fronts. Stlican Shelf, still at our last writing, has rejoined the battle: three base actions inside the final two hours, with Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn the day's most fought-over posts, twenty-nine actions logged in twenty-four hours, and the Colonials holding five works to the Wardens' four. The Dead Lands now bleeds most freely of all — 992 Colonial and 1,371 Warden casualties in two hours, two further base actions, Callahan's Boot the busiest ground, and one work left to no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse has fallen quiet, its last action four hours old, though losses of 797 Colonial and 1,015 Warden in the same span, cooling but heavy, recall the day's thirty-six base actions about Necropolis and Spirit Watch. Godcrofts has recorded no fresh base fighting since evening, yet its casualty returns accelerate sharply, some 223 to each army in two hours, the Wardens keeping seven of nine works. On our count the Colonials hold 259 strategic works against 176 for the Wardens, one base demolished. It is the war's one-hundred-fifty-second day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.

headline: Wardens Press Stlican Shelf Gains; Two Works Lie in Ruin
war_summary: Since our last edition the Wardens have pressed their recovery of the Stlican Shelf, now holding seven of its nine strongpoints, one more than at the previous count, though the pace there has eased — four actions in the past two hours against twenty-two in six, and forty-six in the day, The Pale House alone witnessing eighteen. Weathered Expanse has flared anew: five actions in the past two hours, nineteen at Spirit Watch in a day, and Warden casualties running well ahead of the Colonial rate. For the first time on our count two works lie demolished — one in the Dead Lands, where Callahan's Boot took eight blows, the day's toll neared 19,900, and the last action fell as this edition closed — and one in Godcrofts, where Argosa saw six. Stonecradle's grind persists about The Long Fast, ten events; Callahan's Passage flared at The Latch, which passed through several hands before the Wardens held all ten once more. Linn of Mercy bleeds without pause, near 7,700 casualties in a day, yet not one base action there. On the full board the Colonials hold 260 works to the Wardens' 174, two in ruin. It is the 164th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.

colonial_reinforce.reason: The Spine is the newest Colonial holding (Town Base I taken early today) in the hottest region on the map, where Wardens are still committing heavily; it is the least consolidated Colonial base and the most likely target of a Warden counterattack.

colonial_attack.reason: Warden casualties in Weathered Expanse are surging hard, indicating Wardens are fully committed forward around the ping-pong bases; Huntsfort is the central Warden relic closest to that fighting and can be hit while Warden attrition peaks.

warden_reinforce.reason: Colonial attack pressure in Stonecradle is rising fastest of any local metric and The Long Fast has flipped repeatedly all day; without reinforcement and garrison rotation this Town Base I is the most likely next Warden loss.

warden_attack.reason: Wardens already have their largest engagement in Weathered Expanse and just flattened Necropolis once today; pressing the freshly rebuilt relic before it is fully re-garrisoned is the cheapest follow-up blow on an active axis.

headline: Colonials Reclaim Dead Lands Ruin; Weathered Expanse Blazes On
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition stands in the Dead Lands, where the demolished work beside Callahan's Boot has passed back into Colonial hands, leaving the wreck in Godcrofts the only ruin on the board. The Dead Lands remains the costliest field — some 20,500 casualties in a day, the Warden share the heavier — while Weathered Expanse burns on with twenty-three actions in the same span, six in the past two hours, most at Spirit Watch, and the losses there running nearly even. war_summary: Three hours after our last edition, Godcrofts has reversed its alignment: the Colonials now hold six of its nine works against three Warden, with five Colonial captures logged in the day and fresh flag actions at Argosa, Lipsia and Saegio scarcely an hour old. Weathered Expanse, the day's costliest ground at better than nineteen thousand casualties, has flared anew — nine actions in the past two hours, twenty-seven in twenty-four, Wightwalk and Spirit Watch the storm-centers. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest field by count, forty-seven actions and The Pale House struck twenty times, while the Dead Lands answered with five actions in two hours about Callahan's Boot and eighteen thousand fallen. Linn of Mercy quickened with five actions inside the last two hours; Callahan's Passage, quiet of flags since morning, bled heavily after a double turnover at The Latch. Stonecradle's grind has slackened. No ruin stands anywhere now, the tally reading 270 works Colonial against 159 Warden on the 173rd day, thirty-four victory towns still the prize and no victor named.
